notes.gates: a role gate is a boundary check at the binding, never a proof over the program's internal call paths
notes.reads: a read is a snapshot taken on the locus's own pool, carried with an as_of digest; a live view is a stream

resources.description: Read billing.ledger: a snapshot of a Ledger with its as_of digest, never a live view.
resources.name: billing.ledger

resources.description: Read uptime: a snapshot of a Uptime with its as_of digest, never a live view.
resources.name: uptime

tools.description: Command Audits: sends a Audit to the program; the answer is `accepted` once it is dispatched.
tools.name: Audits

tools.description: Command Refunds: sends a Refund to the program and returns the RefundResult its handler answers with.
tools.name: Refunds

tools.description: Command Ticks: sends a Tick to the program; the answer is `accepted` once it is dispatched.
tools.name: Ticks
